LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Dogge.label: Dogge
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Dogge.description: A medium four-legged machine gun platform whose superior mobility comes from the synthetic artificial muscle bundles in its limbs. Its low height makes it well suited to providing mobile fire support on open ground.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Dogge.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Lady.label: Lady
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Lady.description: The MG-1 Lady is a mech making heavy use of synthetic technology. It was originally designed to reduce the cognitive bias syndrome caused by humans in the military cooperating with mechs over long periods, so most of its anatomy resembles a human's and its internal organs can almost be transplanted directly into a human body. Because its appearance is so excessively human, it is issued only in limited numbers to sniper units and officers as a sniper's spotter or bodyguard.
